title: REQ · BootScene preloads planned assets and falls back for missing ones
summary: BootScene.preload queues planned assets and generates a fallback texture on load error
description: BootScene gains preload() that queues each planned entry (image or spritesheet) with this.load, listens for loaderror to record failed keys, and registers a generated fallback texture so missing assets render a visible marker instead of Phaser's default green box or a crash. The manifest is bundled in runtime/content.ts.
acceptance_criteria: Given a plan with an image and a spritesheet entry, When preload runs, Then this.load.image and this.load.spritesheet are called with the entry key and url
Given a loaderror event for a key, When it fires, Then that key is recorded as failed and the fallback texture exists
Given an unknown ref, When the scene resolves a key, Then the fallback key is returned
